text:
Type: pine five-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens; bedroom, hallway, guest room
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: solid untreated knotty pine, round wooden knobs
Colors: pale natural pine, warm honey knots
Shape: upright chest with a shallow top drawer over four deeper ones, two round knobs on each, slightly overhanging top, straight square legs with a low apron, light frame
Feel: natural, warm, simple, casual
Goes with: white walls, linen bedding, wool throws, black or green accents; Scandinavian, rustic or farmhouse bedrooms

product.name: TARVA
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
